final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT link_to_major, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM member GROUP BY link_to_major), step2 AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) as total_cnt FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s1.link_to_major, s1.cnt, CAST(s1.cnt AS REAL) / s2.total_cnt as prop FROM step1 s1, step2 s2 WHERE s2.total_cnt IS NOT NULL), step4 AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(cnt AS REAL)) as avg_cnt FROM step3) SELECT s3.link_to_major, s3.cnt, s3.prop, CAST(s3.cnt AS REAL) / s4.avg_cnt as deviation_ratio FROM step3 s3, step4 s4 WHERE s4.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL ORDER BY deviation_ratio DESC LIMIT 10
